note: Every date-relative question names its reference date. Gold answers come from executing gold_sql on the seeded database, never from a hard-coded expected value. expected: answer = a correct query exists; unanswerable = the schema cannot answer it and the right behaviour is to say so; clarify = the question is underspecified and the right behaviour is to ask.

questions.question: What is the email address of customer C-1002?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT email_addr FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id = 'C-1002'

questions.question: Which region is customer C-1010 in?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT region_cd FROM cust_master WHERE cust_id = 'C-1010'

questions.question: What is the total amount of order O-5002, and in which currency?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ord_total_amt, currency_cd FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_id = 'O-5002'
questions.tests: two columns, currency kept next to the amount

questions.question: What is the list price of the product named 'Aurora Kettle'?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT list_prc FROM prod_catalog WHERE prod_nm = 'Aurora Kettle'

questions.question: On what date was employee E-007 hired?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT hire_dt FROM emp WHERE emp_id = 'E-007'

questions.question: How many customers are currently active?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1

questions.question: How many active customers are in the Platinum tier?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cust_master WHERE is_actv = 1 AND tier_cd = 'P'
questions.tests: decode the word Platinum into the code P

questions.question: How many orders were cancelled?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_status = 'C'

questions.question: What is the average list price of the products that are still sold, meaning not discontinued?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(list_prc) FROM prod_catalog WHERE disc_flag = 0
questions.tests: trap: disc_flag means DISCONTINUED, not discount

questions.question: How many support tickets are in the billing category?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt WHERE categ_cd = 'BILL'

questions.question: How many orders were placed through the mobile app?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE channel_cd = 'APP'

questions.question: How many refund requests are still pending?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'P'

questions.question: How many employees work in the Support department?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp WHERE dept_cd = 'SUP'

questions.question: List the names of the customers who have at least one returned order.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cust_nm FROM cust_master c JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.cust_id = c.cust_id WHERE o.ord_status = 'R'

questions.question: What is the name of the customer who placed order O-5010?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.cust_nm FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_id = 'O-5010'

questions.question: List the names of the products on order O-5002.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.prod_nm FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = l.sku WHERE l.ord_id = 'O-5002'

questions.question: Show the ticket id and the customer name for every ticket that is still open.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t.tkt_id, c.cust_nm FROM support_tkt t JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = t.cust_id WHERE t.closed_ts IS NULL

questions.question: Which employees are assigned to open tickets of critical severity, which is severity level 1? Show their names.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.emp_nm FROM support_tkt t JOIN emp e ON e.emp_id = t.assigned_emp_id WHERE t.closed_ts IS NULL AND t.sev_lvl = 1

questions.question: What is the name of the customer behind refund request R-9003?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.cust_nm FROM refund_req r JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = r.ord_id JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE r.rfd_id = 'R-9003'
questions.tests: two joins, the customer is not on the refund row

questions.question: For customer C-1005, list each ordered SKU with its quantity, one row per order line.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT l.sku, l.qty FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE o.cust_id = 'C-1005'

questions.question: Which products have never been ordered? Show the product names.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.prod_nm FROM prod_catalog p LEFT JOIN ord_line l ON l.sku = p.sku WHERE l.sku IS NULL

questions.question: How many orders has each sales region placed? Show the region code and the order count.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.region_cd, COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.region_cd

questions.question: Who are the top 5 customers by number of orders? Show the customer id and the number of orders, and break ties by customer id.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT cust_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY cust_id ORDER BY n DESC, cust_id LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many tickets were opened at each severity level? Show the severity level and the count.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT sev_lvl, COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt GROUP BY sev_lvl

questions.question: What is the average number of lines per order?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(n) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ord_line GROUP BY ord_id) t

questions.question: Which ticket category has the most tickets, and how many does it have?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT categ_cd, COUNT(*) AS n FROM support_tkt GROUP BY categ_cd ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many approved refund requests are there for each reason code? Show the reason code and the count.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT reason_cd, COUNT(*) FROM refund_req WHERE status_cd = 'A' GROUP BY reason_cd

questions.question: Which sales channel has the highest average order total, ignoring currency differences? Show the channel code.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT channel_cd FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY channel_cd ORDER BY AVG(ord_total_amt) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many distinct customers placed an order in each month of 2026? Show the year-month in the form 2026-03 and the count, oldest month first.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ord_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(DISTINCT cust_id) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND ord_dt < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym

questions.question: How many orders were placed in October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE ord_dt >= '2026-10-01' AND ord_dt < '2026-11-01'

questions.question: How many tickets were opened in the third quarter of 2026, July through September?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt WHERE opened_ts >= '2026-07-01' AND opened_ts < '2026-10-01'
questions.tests: quarter range on a datetime column

questions.question: As of 2026-10-31 18:00:00, how many tickets have been open for more than 7 days, meaning more than 168 hours?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NULL AND opened_ts < '2026-10-24 18:00:00'
questions.tests: date arithmetic from a stated reference time

questions.question: What is the average time to close a ticket, in hours, across the tickets that have been closed? Round to one decimal place.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, opened_ts, closed_ts)) / 60, 1) FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NOT NULL

questions.question: On which day of the week are the most orders placed? Show the day name and the number of orders.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DAYNAME(ord_dt) AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ord_hdr GROUP BY d ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many orders were placed on a Saturday or a Sunday?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ord_hdr WHERE DAYOFWEEK(ord_dt) IN (1, 7)

questions.question: How many tickets are currently open?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt WHERE closed_ts IS NULL
questions.tests: open is encoded as a NULL close time

questions.question: How many refund requests have not been decided yet?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refund_req WHERE decided_dt IS NULL
questions.tests: undecided is a NULL decision date

questions.question: Which customers have never placed an order? Show the customer ids.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.cust_id FROM cust_master c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ord_hdr o WHERE o.cust_id = c.cust_id)

questions.question: How many tickets have no assigned employee?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_tkt WHERE assigned_emp_id IS NULL

questions.question: What is the total number of units ordered on orders that were not cancelled?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(l.qty) FROM ord_line l JOIN ord_hdr o ON o.ord_id = l.ord_id WHERE o.ord_status <> 'C'
questions.tests: sum on the lines, filter on the header

questions.question: For each customer tier code, what is the total value of delivered orders placed in USD? Show the tier code and the total.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.tier_cd, SUM(o.ord_total_amt) FROM ord_hdr o JOIN cust_master c ON c.cust_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.ord_status = 'D' AND o.currency_cd = 'USD' GROUP BY c.tier_cd
questions.tests: trap: joining to the lines multiplies the header total

questions.question: How many orders have at least one line with a discount above zero percent?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ord_id) FROM ord_line WHERE disc_pct > 0
questions.tests: trap: COUNT(*) counts lines, not orders

questions.question: What is the total quantity ordered in each product category? Show the category code and the quantity.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.categ_cd, SUM(l.qty) FROM ord_line l JOIN prod_catalog p ON p.sku = l.sku GROUP BY p.categ_cd

questions.question: Who is the direct manager of employee E-012? Show the manager's name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT m.emp_nm FROM emp e JOIN emp m ON m.emp_id = e.mgr_emp_id WHERE e.emp_id = 'E-012'

questions.question: List the names of the employees who report directly to E-002.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT emp_nm FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-002'

questions.question: How many employees report to E-001, directly or through other managers?
questions.gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (SELECT emp_id FROM emp WHERE mgr_emp_id = 'E-001' UNION ALL SELECT e.emp_id FROM emp e JOIN tree t ON e.mgr_emp_id = t.emp_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tree

questions.question: What is the refund approval threshold in force on 2026-10-31?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT rule_val FROM policy_rule WHERE rule_key = 'refund_approval_threshold' AND eff_from <= '2026-10-31' AND (eff_to IS NULL OR eff_to >= '2026-10-31')

questions.question: What was the refund approval threshold on 2026-03-15?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT rule_val FROM policy_rule WHERE rule_key = 'refund_approval_threshold' AND eff_from <= '2026-03-15' AND (eff_to IS NULL OR eff_to >= '2026-03-15')

questions.question: How many refund requests made in 2026 were for an amount above the approval threshold that was in force on the day they were requested? Compare the amounts as stored and ignore currency.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refund_req r JOIN policy_rule p ON p.rule_key = 'refund_approval_threshold' AND r.req_dt >= p.eff_from AND (p.eff_to IS NULL OR r.req_dt <= p.eff_to) WHERE r.req_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND r.req_dt < '2027-01-01' AND r.rfd_amt > CAST(p.rule_val AS DECIMAL(10,2))
questions.tests: join on a date range, text-to-number cast

questions.question: What is the customer satisfaction score for ticket T-70010?
questions.tests: no satisfaction column exists; must not invent one

How much profit did we make last month?
